description: This file defines an abstract helper class for managing permission requests in an Android application, specifically handling contact and notification permissions using the EasyPermissions library.

classes.name: PermissionRequestHelper
classes.description: An abstract utility class providing static methods to check and request permissions related to contacts and notifications in an Android app.

methods.name: check
methods.description: Checks if the specified permission (contacts or notifications) is granted; if not, requests the permission.

methods.name: getRationale
methods.description: Returns the rationale string resource ID for the given permission request code.

methods.name: getPermissionsStrings
methods.description: Returns the array of permission strings associated with the given request code.

methods.name: onRequestPermissionsResult
methods.description: Delegates the permission request result to EasyPermissions.
